task: Auto-delete a project's PROJECT-scoped integrations (Settings rows) instead of blocking project deletion when integrations are the only assigned resource.

component_scope.label: S
component_scope.affected: ApplicationRepository.get_project_entity_counts_bulk (integrations_q filtered by setting_type=PROJECT), ProjectService.delete_project / _check_has_no_resources (integrations excluded from the blocking check and auto-deleted via SettingsService)

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Behavior change from blocking project deletion (409) to silently auto-deleting project-scoped integrations; irreversible once executed as part of the same delete flow as the project row itself
technical_risk.mitigation: Reuses existing SettingsService.delete_setting for the actual removal (no new deletion logic introduced); Settings.get_by_project_names scopes the query to the target project only; deleted integration IDs are recorded in the project_deleted activity event (affected_integrations) for audit; unit tests cover the zero-integration skip path, multi-integration deletion, and exclusion of integrations_count from the blocking calculation

key_reasoning.reason: Auto-deleting project integrations during project deletion is an irreversible behavior change (previously blocked with 409, now silently removes data); mitigated by reusing the existing SettingsService.delete_setting pattern, scoping deletion to the target project, recording affected_integrations in the activity event, and thorough test coverage of zero/single/multiple-integration scenarios.
4 files modified per diffstat (repository, service, and their two existing test files) — no new files created; maps to the M band under the file-count mapping (4-6 files = M).
